extraction.title: What’s in the pipeline
extraction.subtitle: Swashbuckling oil-services firms are preparing for a boom Post-war reconstruction and efforts to diversify production will present big opportunities
extraction.summary: Oil-services firms are poised for growth due to post-war reconstruction opportunities in the Middle East and a potential increase in investment from oil majors. Despite short-term challenges from geopolitical tensions, the long-term outlook suggests a significant boom in the sector.
